title: Go Fast email deleted under the spillage protocol

tellings.quote: the story he told me what happened is when it was deleted they were still not sure whether it was adversary tech or or off-world

plain: An email carrying the Go Fast video, a 2015 Navy recording of a fast object skimming over the ocean, was reportedly deleted from Navy networks under the spillage protocol, the procedure for wiping classified material sent where it should not be. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, tells Michels what Jay Stratton, an intelligence officer who led Pentagon UFO work, told him: when it was deleted, "they were still not sure whether it was adversary tech or off-world."
